scope: The actual complete_scene_frame function requires successful source application, an exact successor version and a detached native candidate before apply_patches_result may replace the active view.

ordered_stages.domain: all source-success bools, all u64 source/successor versions and all candidate-ready bools

checks: foreign-owner rejection preserved identity and clean needs_frame state
source-rejected missing-node frame preserved identity, bounds, pixels and clean needs_frame state
native-candidate rejection preserved identity, bounds, pixels and clean needs_frame state
a later valid update from the retained old expected version succeeded
accepted candidate pixels equal a fresh import of the terminal source

decision: apply_patches_result no longer invalidates the active frame before admission. A rejected admission or candidate now leaves the complete active view, including frame cache and dirty state, unchanged. The candidate is assigned only after the verified completion gate succeeds.
limits: The gate does not prove ScenePatch application, Blitz candidate construction, restore behavior or third-party panic rollback.
The candidate is rebuilt in full for accepted frames; this is not a performance result.
Checklist item 2 remains incomplete because full implementation-level candidate/replace and actual display presentation are still pending.
